title: [Idea] The Dream Fusion of CTB and Turn-Based Combat

blocks.source: 【アイデア】ＣＴＢとターン制の夢の融合
blocks.translation: [Idea] The Dream Fusion of CTB and Turn-Based Combat

blocks.source: →マジで実装しました！ ＲＰＧツクールＭＺ～ＭＶで使用できます。
blocks.translation: → I actually implemented it! It can be used with RPG Maker MZ & MV.

blocks.source: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/472839675.html
blocks.translation: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/472839675.html

blocks.source: 以前も書きましたが、新しい行動順序システムを作るのは難しいのが現実です。
blocks.translation: As I have written before, the reality is that creating a new action order system is difficult.

blocks.source: そのため、『リアルタイム制』を除いたコマンド式ＲＰＧの戦闘システムとしては、『ターン制』『ＣＴＢ』のどちらかに類するものを使うのが、一般的でした。
blocks.translation: Therefore, excluding real-time systems, command-based RPG battle systems have generally used something resembling either turn-based combat or CTB.

blocks.source: 世に出回るフリゲも市販ＲＰＧも、大半がこのどちらかを採用している状況です。
blocks.translation: Most freeware games and commercial RPGs available today use one or the other.

blocks.source: しかしながら、それだけでは戦闘システムの幅は狭まってしまいます。ＲＰＧの歴史の中では『プレスターン』などの新しい試みがされてきましたが、もっと色々とあっていいはず。
blocks.translation: However, relying only on those systems narrows the range of possible battle systems. RPGs have seen new attempts such as Press Turn, but there should be room for many more possibilities.

blocks.source: そこで『ターン制』と『ＣＴＢ』のいいとこ取りができないかと考えました。
blocks.translation: So I wondered whether it would be possible to combine the best aspects of turn-based combat and CTB.

blocks.source: 同時に多人数の行動を決める緊張感あるターン制
blocks.translation: Tense turn-based combat, where multiple characters’ actions are decided simultaneously

blocks.source: 素早さの重要性が高いＣＴＢ
blocks.translation: CTB, where agility is highly important

blocks.source: このような特徴を融合できないか――というわけです。
blocks.translation: In other words, could these characteristics be fused together?

blocks.source: 素早さの価値を高めたターン制といえば、ブレスオブファイア３のＥＸターンが挙げられます。
blocks.translation: When it comes to turn-based systems that increase the value of agility, Breath of Fire III’s EX Turn comes to mind.

blocks.source: これは『素早さが敵平均より二倍高いキャラ』に限り二回行動できるというものです。ただ極端過ぎる嫌いはありますし、逆に条件を満たさない限りはシステムとして空気です。
blocks.translation: This allows only characters whose agility is twice as high as the enemy average to act twice. However, it may be too extreme, and conversely, the system is practically irrelevant unless the condition is met.

blocks.source: あれよりも明確にシステムとして組み込みたいところです。
blocks.translation: I wanted to incorporate that concept more clearly into the system.

blocks.source: 試案
blocks.translation: Prototype

blocks.source: ではどうするのか――というと、具体的にはＣＴＢを『何らかの行動回数』で区切って、ターン制のような挙動にします。
blocks.translation: So how would it work? Specifically, I would divide CTB based on a certain number of actions and make it behave like a turn-based system.

blocks.source: まず思いついたのは『戦闘に参加している人数』で区切ることです。
blocks.translation: The first idea that came to mind was dividing it based on the number of participants in the battle.

blocks.source: 画像は既存のＣＴＢをいじったイメージです。緑の矢印から上がそのターン内での行動者です。
blocks.translation: The image shows a modified version of the existing CTB system. The characters from the green arrow upward are the ones acting during that turn.

blocks.source: 味方３人、敵３体なので１ターンの行動回数は全員合わせて６回となります。
blocks.translation: Since there are three allies and three enemies, the total number of actions per turn is six.

blocks.source: 遅い敵はそのターン中は行動できなくなる代わりに、２回行動できる味方が発生します。遅いキャラの出番を速いキャラが奪い取るようなイメージですね。
blocks.translation: The slower enemies lose their chance to act during that turn, while some allies get to act twice. The idea is that faster characters take over the turns of slower ones.

blocks.source: これで一応の形ができました。
blocks.translation: This gave me a workable system, at least for the time being.

blocks.source: ターン制とＣＴＢの特徴を併せ持った行動順序システムが設計できたような気がしないでもありません。
blocks.translation: I felt that I had managed to design an action order system combining the characteristics of turn-based combat and CTB.

blocks.source: ……が、問題もありました。
blocks.translation: …But there were problems as well.

blocks.source: 遅いキャラの行動を速いキャラが乗っ取るという仕様上、遅いキャラが想定以上に足を引っ張ることになります。
blocks.translation: Because faster characters take over the actions of slower ones, slower characters end up hindering the party more than expected.

blocks.source: 例を挙げると、ＣＴＢ（４人参加）で以下の順番であった場合……
blocks.translation: For example, suppose the order in a CTB battle with four participants is as follows…

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ→Ａ
blocks.translation: A→B→C→A

blocks.source: Ｄ→Ｂ→Ｃ→Ａ
blocks.translation: D→B→C→A

blocks.source: ※アルファベットがキャラクターに該当します。
blocks.translation: ※The letters represent the characters.

blocks.source: 新システムでは……
blocks.translation: Under the new system…

blocks.source: １ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 1:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ→Ａ
blocks.translation: A→B→C→A

blocks.source: ２ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 2:

blocks.source: Ｄ→Ｂ→Ｃ→Ａ
blocks.translation: D→B→C→A

blocks.source: という行動ターンになります。
blocks.translation: the action turns would be as follows.

blocks.source: 素早さの低いＤの１ターン目が、Ａによって奪われていることが分かります。
blocks.translation: You can see that D’s first turn, due to having low agility, has been taken by A.

blocks.source: Ａが敵でＢ～Ｄが味方ならば、１ターン目に２回の攻撃をされてしまうわけです。
blocks.translation: If A is an enemy and B–D are allies, they will be attacked twice during the first turn.

blocks.source: １ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 1:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→B→C

blocks.source: ２ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 2:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→B→C

blocks.source: 上記のように、Ｄを除いた３人の戦いならば、２回攻撃は発生しません。下手すれば、鈍足のＤを戦闘不能にしておくような戦術が有利になってしまいます。
blocks.translation: As shown above, if the battle involves only the three characters other than D, no one attacks twice. In the worst case, a strategy that keeps slow D incapacitated could even become advantageous.

blocks.source: 遅いキャラが不利なのはＣＴＢの宿命とはいえ、これはやり過ぎでしょう。何だかいびつなシステムに思えてしまいます。
blocks.translation: Although slower characters being disadvantaged is an unavoidable aspect of CTB, this goes too far. The system ends up feeling somehow distorted.

blocks.source: 改良案
blocks.translation: Improvement Proposal

blocks.source: 「１ターンの行動を限定する」という方向性は悪くないように思いますが、どうにもしっくりきません。
blocks.translation: The idea of limiting the actions taken in one turn does not seem bad, but it just does not feel quite right.

blocks.source: ならば、その条件を変えてはどうでしょうか？
blocks.translation: If so, why not change the condition?

blocks.source: 思いついたのは、『最も速いキャラ』を基準にすることです。
blocks.translation: What I came up with was using the fastest character as the 기준.

blocks.source: 具体的には『同じキャラ』の順番が２回来たら、その手前でターンを区切ります。
blocks.translation: Specifically, when the same character’s turn comes up for the second time, the turn ends just before that action.

blocks.source: ※大抵は『最も速いキャラ』が対象になりますが、補助・異常などで複雑に変化することもありえます。そのため『同じキャラの順番が２回』を条件にしたほうが汎用的です。
blocks.translation: ※Usually, the fastest character will be the one concerned, but their order can change in complex ways due to buffs, ailments, and so on. Therefore, using “the same character’s turn occurring twice” as the condition is more versatile.

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→B→C

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｄ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→D→B→C

blocks.source: １ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 1:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→B→C

blocks.source: ２ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 2:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｄ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→D→B→C

blocks.source: というようにＡを基準に区切ります。
blocks.translation: Thus, the turns are divided based on A.

blocks.source: １ターン目だけ最も遅いキャラ――すなわちＤが脱落していることが分かるでしょう。
blocks.translation: You can see that only in the first turn, the slowest character—in other words, D—is left out.

blocks.source: ターン毎に参加人数が可変になるという点が特徴的ですね。
blocks.translation: A notable feature is that the number of participants can vary from turn to turn.

blocks.source: 他の例も考えてみます。
blocks.translation: Let’s consider another example.

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→B→C

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｄ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→D→B→C

blocks.source: Ａ
blocks.translation: A

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ→Ｄ
blocks.translation: A→B→C→D

blocks.source: １ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 1:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→B→C

blocks.source: ２ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 2:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｄ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→D→B→C

blocks.source: ３ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 3:

blocks.source: Ａ
blocks.translation: A

blocks.source: ４ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 4:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ→Ｄ
blocks.translation: A→B→C→D

blocks.source: 見ての通り、毎ターン行動するキャラと順序が流動的に変わっていきます。
blocks.translation: As you can see, the characters who act each turn and their order change fluidly.

blocks.source: 順序については、ターン内で再び素早さで並び替えるのもよいかもしれません。かなり雰囲気がターン制に近づくと思います。
blocks.translation: As for the order, it might be a good idea to sort them by Agility again within each turn. I think this would make it feel much more like a turn-based system.

blocks.source: ＣＴＢにおけるキャラの連続行動は、そのキャラ単独のターンとなります。この場合では３ターン目のＡが該当します。単独ターンではなく、前後のターンと合併して２回行動にするのも面白そうです。
blocks.translation: In CTB, a character's consecutive actions constitute a turn for that character alone. In this case, A's action on Turn 3 is an example. Instead of having a solo turn, it might be interesting to merge it with the preceding or following turn and give the character two actions.

blocks.source: このルールならば、鈍足のＤが大きく足を引っ張ることもないので、不公平感はなさそうですね。
blocks.translation: Under these rules, Slow D would not significantly hold everyone back, so it does not seem unfair.

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→B→C

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｄ→Ｂ
blocks.translation: A→D→B

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→C

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｄ
blocks.translation: A→B→D

blocks.source: １ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 1:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→B→C

blocks.source: ２ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 2:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｄ→Ｂ
blocks.translation: A→D→B

blocks.source: ３ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 3:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｃ
blocks.translation: A→C

blocks.source: ４ターン目：
blocks.translation: Turn 4:

blocks.source: Ａ→Ｂ→Ｄ
blocks.translation: A→B→D

blocks.source: 一つ気になるとすれば、このパターンです。
blocks.translation: There is one pattern that concerns me.

blocks.source: ２ターン目に『鈍足のＤ』は動けるのに『Ｄより速いＣ』が動けない逆転現象が発生しています。３ターン目も同様で、Ｂは動けないのに『Ｂより遅いＣ』は動ける状況になっています。
blocks.translation: On Turn 2, a reversal occurs: Slow D can act, while C, who is faster than D, cannot. The same thing happens on Turn 3: B cannot act, while C, who is slower than B, can.

blocks.source: もっとも、場合によっては遅いキャラが有利なのは、ターン制時点からの伝統です。あまり気にする必要はないかもしれませんが。
blocks.translation: Then again, slower characters having an advantage in certain situations is a tradition dating back to turn-based systems. Perhaps it is not something to worry about too much.

blocks.source: ……というわけで、ここに新しい行動順序システムが完成しました。プログラムとして実装したわけではありませんが、ここまで設計できれば十分だと思います。
blocks.translation: And so, a new action order system has been completed here. I have not implemented it as a program, but I think designing it this far is sufficient.

blocks.source: 特に調べてはいませんが、アイデアとしては自分が初めてのはず。
blocks.translation: I have not researched this specifically, but I believe this is the first time this idea has been proposed.

blocks.source: というか、ＣＴＢだけでもわりと面倒なのに、その上で細工しようと考える人はあまりないと思います。
blocks.translation: I mean, CTB is already fairly complicated, so I doubt many people would think of tinkering with it further.

blocks.source: 命名はカウントターンバトル――にしようかと思いましたが、略称がかぶるので思い留まりました。
blocks.translation: I considered naming it Count Turn Battle, but I decided against it because the abbreviation would overlap with another one.

blocks.source: カウントタイムターンバトル――略してＣＴＴＢ
blocks.translation: Count Time Turn Battle—abbreviated CTTB

blocks.source: としておきます。
blocks.translation: I'll call it that.

blocks.source: ＣＴＴＢまとめ
blocks.translation: CTTB Summary

blocks.source: 利点
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: 素早さの価値が高い。
blocks.translation: Agility has a high value.

blocks.source: ターン制独自の緊張感や戦術性を持ち込める。
blocks.translation: It brings in the tension and tactical depth unique to turn-based systems.

blocks.source: サガシリーズの連携など、ターン制向きのシステムも使える。
blocks.translation: It allows the use of systems suited to turn-based gameplay, such as the combo system from the SaGa series.

blocks.source: ターン毎に状況が流動的に変わっていくので刺激的。
blocks.translation: It is exciting because the situation changes fluidly with each turn.

blocks.source: 今までにないシステムなので新鮮さがある。
blocks.translation: It feels fresh because it is a system unlike anything seen before.

blocks.source: それでいて感覚はターン制に近いので馴染みやすい。
blocks.translation: Even so, it feels close to a turn-based system, making it easy to get accustomed to.

blocks.source: まんま、いいとこ取りですね。まさに夢の融合！
blocks.translation: It really does take the best of both worlds. A truly dreamlike fusion!

blocks.source: 最大の欠点は「別にＣＴＢでよくね？」というツッコミかもしれません。
blocks.translation: Its biggest drawback may be the criticism: “Why not just use CTB?”

blocks.source: ターン制に関しては『素早さ』という明確な差別化ができるので心配いりませんが、問題はＣＴＢを相手にした場合でしょう。
blocks.translation: There is no need to worry about turn-based systems, since Agility provides a clear point of differentiation. The question is what happens when it is compared with CTB.

blocks.source: ターン制的な面白さを持ち込めないなら、わざわざＣＴＢを余計な劣化させただけになりかねません。夢の融合どころか下手すりゃ中途半端の誕生です。
blocks.translation: If it cannot bring in the fun of turn-based systems, it may end up being nothing more than an unnecessarily degraded version of CTB. Far from a dreamlike fusion, it could wind up as something half-baked.

blocks.source: これを書いた当人も、ＣＴＢより面白いかと言われると確信はありません。面白いかどうかは、実際には調理次第といったところでしょう。
blocks.translation: Even I, the person who wrote this, cannot say for certain that it is more fun than CTB. Whether it is fun or not will ultimately depend on how it is put together.

blocks.source: とはいえ、新システムというのはゲームデザイナーのロマンです。機会があれば挑戦してみたいと思います。
blocks.translation: That said, creating a new system is a game designer's dream. If I get the opportunity, I would like to give it a try.

blocks.source: ※絶対にやるとは断言しません。やってみてつまらなかったら意味がないので。
blocks.translation: ※I am not saying that I will definitely do it. If I try it and it turns out to be boring, there would be no point.

blocks.source: そんなわけで、ターン制とＣＴＢの両方が好きな方は、ＣＴＴＢに挑戦してみてはいかがでしょうか？
blocks.translation: So, if you like both turn-based systems and CTB, why not give CTTB a try?

texts.遅いキャラが不利なのはＣＴＢの宿命とはいえ、これはやり過ぎでしょう。何だかいびつ: Although slower characters being disadvantaged is an unavoidable aspect of CTB, this goes too far. The system ends up feeling somehow distorted.
texts.「１ターンの行動を限定する」という方向性は悪くないように思いますが、どうにもしっ: The idea of limiting the actions taken in one turn does not seem bad, but it just does not feel quite right.
texts.ならば、その条件を変えてはどうでしょうか？: If so, why not change the condition?
texts.思いついたのは、『最も速いキャラ』を基準にすることです。: What I came up with was using the fastest character as the 기준.
texts.具体的には『同じキャラ』の順番が２回来たら、その手前でターンを区切ります。: Specifically, when the same character’s turn comes up for the second time, the turn ends just before that action.
texts.※大抵は『最も速いキャラ』が対象になりますが、補助・異常などで複雑に変化すること: ※Usually, the fastest character will be the one concerned, but their order can change in complex ways due to buffs, ailments, and so on. Therefore, using “the same character’s turn occurring twice” as the condition is more versatile.
texts.というようにＡを基準に区切ります。: Thus, the turns are divided based on A.
texts.１ターン目だけ最も遅いキャラ――すなわちＤが脱落していることが分かるでしょう。: You can see that only in the first turn, the slowest character—in other words, D—is left out.
texts.ターン毎に参加人数が可変になるという点が特徴的ですね。: A notable feature is that the number of participants can vary from turn to turn.
texts.見ての通り、毎ターン行動するキャラと順序が流動的に変わっていきます。: As you can see, the characters who act each turn and their order change fluidly.
texts.順序については、ターン内で再び素早さで並び替えるのもよいかもしれません。かなり雰: As for the order, it might be a good idea to sort them by Agility again within each turn. I think this would make it feel much more like a turn-based system.
texts.ＣＴＢにおけるキャラの連続行動は、そのキャラ単独のターンとなります。この場合では: In CTB, a character's consecutive actions constitute a turn for that character alone. In this case, A's action on Turn 3 is an example. Instead of having a solo turn, it might be interesting to merge it with the preceding or following turn and give the character two actions.
texts.このルールならば、鈍足のＤが大きく足を引っ張ることもないので、不公平感はなさそう: Under these rules, Slow D would not significantly hold everyone back, so it does not seem unfair.
texts.一つ気になるとすれば、このパターンです。: There is one pattern that concerns me.
texts.２ターン目に『鈍足のＤ』は動けるのに『Ｄより速いＣ』が動けない逆転現象が発生して: On Turn 2, a reversal occurs: Slow D can act, while C, who is faster than D, cannot. The same thing happens on Turn 3: B cannot act, while C, who is slower than B, can.
texts.もっとも、場合によっては遅いキャラが有利なのは、ターン制時点からの伝統です。あま: Then again, slower characters having an advantage in certain situations is a tradition dating back to turn-based systems. Perhaps it is not something to worry about too much.
texts.……というわけで、ここに新しい行動順序システムが完成しました。プログラムとして実: And so, a new action order system has been completed here. I have not implemented it as a program, but I think designing it this far is sufficient.
texts.特に調べてはいませんが、アイデアとしては自分が初めてのはず。: I have not researched this specifically, but I believe this is the first time this idea has been proposed.
texts.というか、ＣＴＢだけでもわりと面倒なのに、その上で細工しようと考える人はあまりな: I mean, CTB is already fairly complicated, so I doubt many people would think of tinkering with it further.
texts.命名はカウントターンバトル――にしようかと思いましたが、略称がかぶるので思い留ま: I considered naming it Count Turn Battle, but I decided against it because the abbreviation would overlap with another one.
texts.ターン制独自の緊張感や戦術性を持ち込める。: It brings in the tension and tactical depth unique to turn-based systems.
texts.サガシリーズの連携など、ターン制向きのシステムも使える。: It allows the use of systems suited to turn-based gameplay, such as the combo system from the SaGa series.
texts.ターン毎に状況が流動的に変わっていくので刺激的。: It is exciting because the situation changes fluidly with each turn.
texts.今までにないシステムなので新鮮さがある。: It feels fresh because it is a system unlike anything seen before.
texts.それでいて感覚はターン制に近いので馴染みやすい。: Even so, it feels close to a turn-based system, making it easy to get accustomed to.
texts.まんま、いいとこ取りですね。まさに夢の融合！: It really does take the best of both worlds. A truly dreamlike fusion!
texts.最大の欠点は「別にＣＴＢでよくね？」というツッコミかもしれません。: Its biggest drawback may be the criticism: “Why not just use CTB?”
texts.ターン制に関しては『素早さ』という明確な差別化ができるので心配いりませんが、問題: There is no need to worry about turn-based systems, since Agility provides a clear point of differentiation. The question is what happens when it is compared with CTB.
texts.ターン制的な面白さを持ち込めないなら、わざわざＣＴＢを余計な劣化させただけになり: If it cannot bring in the fun of turn-based systems, it may end up being nothing more than an unnecessarily degraded version of CTB. Far from a dreamlike fusion, it could wind up as something half-baked.
texts.これを書いた当人も、ＣＴＢより面白いかと言われると確信はありません。面白いかどう: Even I, the person who wrote this, cannot say for certain that it is more fun than CTB. Whether it is fun or not will ultimately depend on how it is put together.
texts.とはいえ、新システムというのはゲームデザイナーのロマンです。機会があれば挑戦して: That said, creating a new system is a game designer's dream. If I get the opportunity, I would like to give it a try.
texts.※絶対にやるとは断言しません。やってみてつまらなかったら意味がないので。: ※I am not saying that I will definitely do it. If I try it and it turns out to be boring, there would be no point.
texts.そんなわけで、ターン制とＣＴＢの両方が好きな方は、ＣＴＴＢに挑戦してみてはいかが: So, if you like both turn-based systems and CTB, why not give CTTB a try?
